one_line: Indo-Persian poet, court chronicler and Sufi disciple in 13th–14th century Delhi.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, lean but sturdy build, the calm bearing of a seasoned court poet and mystic.
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-brown North Indian complexion, straight nose, gently arched brows, thoughtful large anime-style eyes, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, a faint smile that feels both playful and contemplative.
appearance.hair: Dark brown hair, straight and medium length, mostly hidden under a soft, rounded white Turkic-style cap fitted close to the head, with a simple narrow band of muted turquoise embroidery around its base.
appearance.costume: A long Indo-Persian jama-style robe in soft matte indigo cotton, knee-length, with cross-over front tied on the right and slim off-white edging; beneath it a full-sleeved off-white cotton tunic visible at collar and cuffs; loose straight trousers in muted sand-beige; a wide woven waist sash in deep maroon with subtle gold thread pattern wrapped twice and knotted at the left hip, ends hanging to mid-thigh; simple leather shoes in dark brown with slightly upturned toes; around his neck a plain, medium-length wooden bead mala hinting at his Sufi affiliation.
appearance.signature: A rolled manuscript of Persian poetry tied with a thin maroon cord in his left hand, and at his side a simple, era-appropriate long-necked tanpura-like stringed instrument in polished pale brown wood held in his right hand or resting against his leg, symbolising his musical-poetic legacy without claiming later inventions.

ref_desc: Amir Khusrau is a mid-40s lean man with medium-brown complexion, short beard, rounded white embroidered cap, indigo jama over off-white tunic, sand-beige trousers, maroon sash, wooden bead mala, and he carries a rolled manuscript plus a pale brown long-necked tanpura-like instrument in an indigo–maroon–beige palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Amir Khusrau: a mid-40s lean man with an oval medium-brown North Indian face, straight nose, large thoughtful eyes, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, wearing a soft rounded white Turkic-style cap with a narrow band of muted turquoise embroidery. Show him in a knee-length indigo cotton jama-style robe with a cross-over front tied on the right and slim off-white edging, over a full-sleeved off-white tunic visible at the collar and cuffs, with loose straight sand-beige trousers and dark brown slightly upturned leather shoes. Wrap a wide maroon woven waist sash with subtle gold thread around his waist, knotted at the left hip with its ends hanging, and add a plain wooden bead mala around his neck to suggest his Sufi connection. In his left hand he holds a rolled Persian manuscript tied with a thin maroon cord, and beside him or lightly held in his right hand is a simple polished pale brown long-necked tanpura-like stringed instrument. Emphasise clear, repeatable details of face, cap, beard, robe, sash, trousers, shoes, mala, manuscript and instrument, using a harmonious palette of indigo, off-white, sand beige, maroon, dark brown and touches of turquoise.
